subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The board did not make them work harder.”?
options: Sometimes they only wait quietly for someone to notice.
It is also about what happens along the way.
The way to school became part of the lesson.
It simply gave others a way to notice them.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes they only wait quietly for someone to notice.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about what happens along the way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The way to school became part of the lesson.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The board did not make them work harder. It simply gave others a way to notice them.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The board did not make them work harder. It simply gave others a way to notice them.」，答案為「It simply gave others a way to notice them.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It simply gave others a way to notice them.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
